comment: Designer/Command choices from the EL-006 cycle order, section 2. Hypothesis thresholds, NEVER tuned on real data; synthetic streams only. Changing any value changes the pinned hash.

confidence.comment: confidence = rule margin x coverage x mean detector quality, capped below the fusion caps.

features.comment: gaze_away is a head-orientation PROXY (eye-midpoint to nose offset over inter-ocular distance), not gaze. Weights apply to FER7 probabilities.

gates.comment: Below these the output is INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE; more than one face in the window is never analysed.

name: HB-1

needs_help_like.comment: temporal escalation only: dwell > dwell_s AND (nervous-like or unsure-like firing in >= sustain_fraction of the evaluation points over the last 2 windows) AND gaze_away episodes >= episodes_min.

nervous_like.comment: high p_neg_arousal AND (head_jitter high OR arousal high). Margin = clip((x - thr) / span, 0, 1); AND = min, OR = max.

unsure_like.comment: (neutral OR low-confidence expression) AND hesitation high AND gaze_away moderate (band) AND low arousal.

window.comment: W = 3 s; minimum 2 s at >= 5 usable fps; expected_fps is the paced-loop target midpoint (8-10 fps).
